summary: Adds a Rust/Buck2 manifest checker guard that rejects unpinned host interpreters in active runtime hook text, making interpreter-free hook hot paths a static read-only policy rather than only a shell fixture expectation.

facets.F1_scope: P00 read-only hook enhancement slice; Rust manifest checker, its unit test, repo-hygiene backlog status, and audit evidence changed.
facets.F2_source_authority: docs/AGENTS.md, specs/agent-hook-runtime-manifest.json, specs/repo-hygiene-automation.json, Git hooks docs, GitHub Actions security hardening, SLSA requirements, OWASP LLM Top 10.
F3_tests: RED: rustc --edition=2024 -D warnings scripts/tests/agent_hook_runtime_manifest_check.rs --test ... failed before guard with rejects_unpinned_host_interpreters_in_runtime_hooks
buck2 build //:agent-hook-runtime-manifest-check //:repo-hygiene-automation-check //:buck2-authority-policy-check; BUILD SUCCEEDED, Build ID ce8fb4bc-f210-44ba-9b88-d504e961e3a1
facets.F4_security: Runtime hook files now fail static Buck2/Prow evidence if they invoke unpinned host interpreter/toolchain commands such as python3, node, pnpm, npm, npx, bun, deno, ruby, perl, php, or lua.
facets.F5_privacy: No runtime behavior or payload persistence changed.
facets.F6_reliability: Adds a targeted RED/GREEN regression fixture and reuses the existing manifest checker path consumed by Buck2/Prow.
facets.F7_operability: No hook command path changed; static checker remains read-only and local/static.
facets.F8_performance: No runtime cost added; guard runs in the existing Buck2 manifest checker lane.
facets.F9_maintainability: Centralizes interpreter-drift policy in Rust rather than repeating per-hook grep fixtures.
facets.F10_compatibility: Checked-in runtime hooks continue to pass; bootstrap shell glue remains allowed when explicitly reviewed outside this active runtime hook guard.
